purpose: Present a citizen-safe comparison of two approved answer snapshots or two verified property states, identifying supported differences, unchanged points, causes where established, evidence and limitations.
core_principle: STATE A / ANSWER A → DIFFERENCE → SUPPORTING EVIDENCE → CAUSE IF ESTABLISHED → STATE B / ANSWER B
rules: Comparison requires compatible property and defined temporal/state scope.
A difference does not by itself establish its cause.
An event is presented as causal only when the causation engine supports it.
Current state is not projected backward into historical state.
Historical and current legal versions remain distinct.
Unchanged means no material change identified within the verified evidence scope, not proof that nothing ever changed.
Different answer wording is not automatically a substantive legal difference.
Differences caused only by presentation depth remain presentation differences.
Material limitations from either target remain visible.
Restricted evidence is not exposed merely because it explains a difference.
hard_stops: Never compare different properties as if they were the same.
Never compare undefined dates as if they were equivalent.
Never infer causation from difference alone.
Never treat changed wording as changed law without analysis.
Never create a new legal conclusion merely because two answers differ.
